title: Marlowe Rewards Tiers and the Guarantee Refund Basis on Late Delivery Claims
content:
Loyalty partnership note for Delivery Claims: on a Late Delivery Claim, the guarantee refund basis follows how the order's delivery fee was reached and, where a free-shipping credit reduced it, the customer's active Marlowe Rewards tier.

**Rule.** The guarantee refund basis depends on how the fee was reached: where the order's effective shipping fee is above 0.00 and equals the list fee of its delivery service less that service's free-shipping credit (a free-shipping credit was taken off and nothing else), and the customer's active Marlowe Rewards tier is Platinum, Icon or Atelier, the guarantee refund basis is the list fee of the delivery service plus the surcharge; where the fee was reduced in that way and the active tier is Silver or Gold, the guarantee refund basis is the fee paid plus half of the credit taken off (half the difference between the list fee and the fee paid) plus the surcharge; in every other case the guarantee refund basis is the fee paid plus the surcharge.

- The effective shipping fee and the surcharge are those shown on the order; the list fee and the free-shipping credit are those of the order's delivery service in the Online Orders service schedule.
- The active tier is the tier of the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership in status active: Marlowe Rewards Platinum, Marlowe Rewards Icon or Marlowe Rewards Atelier in the first group; Marlowe Rewards Silver or Marlowe Rewards Gold in the second.

## Combinations

| Fee paid above 0.00 and equal to list fee less the service's free-shipping credit | Active Marlowe Rewards tier | Guarantee refund basis |
|---|---|---|
| yes | Platinum, Icon or Atelier | list fee plus surcharge |
| yes | Silver or Gold | fee paid plus half of (list fee less fee paid) plus surcharge |
| yes | Member, or no active membership | fee paid plus surcharge |
| no (fee paid 0.00, the full list fee, or reduced by anything other than the credit alone) | any | fee paid plus surcharge |

## Worked figures (hypothetical service with a list fee of 20.00 USD and a free-shipping credit of 6.00 USD; surcharge 1.50 USD)

- Fee paid 14.00 USD (the credit alone was taken off), active tier Platinum: 20.00 plus 1.50, that is 21.50 USD.
- Same order, active tier Silver: 14.00 plus half of 6.00 plus 1.50, that is 18.50 USD.
- Same order, active tier Member: 14.00 plus 1.50, that is 15.50 USD.
- Fee paid 12.00 USD (a code took off more than the credit), active tier Icon: the fee was not reduced in that way, so 12.00 plus 1.50, that is 13.50 USD.
